page.title: Help Me Pray
page.intro: Choose what you are carrying today. Find a small step toward prayer, with sources and clear limits.
page.reviewNotice: This guide is a private draft awaiting faith, source, and language review. Prayer text and Begin are not available while a card is in review.
page.boundaryHeading: Prayer and the help you need
page.boundaryCopy: This guide offers devotional guidance, not a sacrament, diagnosis, or promise of healing. For confession or personal spiritual direction, speak with a priest. Keep receiving medical care, and seek urgent local help in a crisis.
page.privacyCopy: You do not need to enter your name, prayer intention, or personal details to use this guide.
page.pendingNotice: Cards marked "In review" are not ready to use. Their prayer text and Begin action are unavailable.

privacyCaveat: Privacy wording describes an input-free shell only, not unverified analytics/storage behavior. Public pendingNotice is a separate candidate key; private reviewNotice must never be compiled into the public page.
